TOGAWASAKIKO-ENCHANTED_HAIRBAND.descript: At the end of combat, add a random [gold]upgraded[/gold] card to your deck.
TOGAWASAKIKO-BLAZING_HAIRBAND.descriptio: Replace [red]Monochrome[/red] [red]Hairband[/red]. At the end of combat, add a random card to your deck.
TOGAWASAKIKO-BLAZING_HAIRBAND.title: Blazing Hairband
TOGAWASAKIKO-COLORFUL_NOTEBOOK.descripti: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dazzling[/gold].
TOGAWASAKIKO-COLORFUL_NOTEBOOK.title: Colorful Notebook
TOGAWASAKIKO-CUTE_ANIMAL_BAND_AID.descri: When obtaining a reward after battle, heal [blue]1[/blue] HP.
TOGAWASAKIKO-CUTE_ANIMAL_BAND_AID.flavor: A box of assorted small animal-themed band-aids, perfect for healing bumps and bruises!
TOGAWASAKIKO-CUTE_ANIMAL_BAND_AID.title: Cute Animal Band-Aid
TOGAWASAKIKO-FOUNTAIN_DRINK.description: Whenever your potion slots are full, gain a potion at the end of combat.
TOGAWASAKIKO-FOUNTAIN_DRINK.flavor: You feel that this mystery machine contains mythical power, and only you don't quite know how to use it.
TOGAWASAKIKO-FOUNTAIN_DRINK.title: Vending Machine Drinks
TOGAWASAKIKO-GOLDEN_POCKET_WATCH.title: Golden Pocket Watch
TOGAWASAKIKO-MASQUERADE_MASK.description: Whenever you [gold]Purge[/gold] 3 card during battle, gain a [gold]Purge[/gold] reward at the end of the battle.
TOGAWASAKIKO-MASQUERADE_MASK.flavor: An abandoned mask lay right on the floor. Seems cheaply made.
TOGAWASAKIKO-MASQUERADE_MASK.title: Masquerade Mask
TOGAWASAKIKO-STARTER_RELIC_TOGAWA_SAKIKO: At the end of combat, add a [gold]Desire[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
The past sustained, the self constrained, and the knot of conflicting desire.
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_COMPASS.description: Whenever your turn ends, you gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dazzling[/gold], all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dazzling[/gold].
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_COMPASS.flavor: Like the needle spinning between two poles of fate, our destinies align in its eternal dance.
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_COMPASS.title: The Compass
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_DOLL.description: At the start of your 2nd turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Hype[/gold].
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_DOLL.flavor: There is nothing left but the warmth of her doll's embrace.
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_DOLL.title: The Doll
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_THIRD_MOVEMENT.descript: The next [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Moonlight Sonata[/gold] cards you play deal [blue]3[/blue] times damage.
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_THIRD_MOVEMENT.flavor: The music reaches its climax, and the story comes to an end.
TOGAWASAKIKO-THE_THIRD_MOVEMENT.title: The Third Movement

A reinforced tea cup for insulation.
The lid is tightly embedded and difficult to remove.

TOGAWASAKIKO-ANOTHER_MASK.flavor: A white mask, and a chance to begin again.
